summary: Official AJK sources document a GIS-based cadastral mapping project for state-owned land and an associated ArcGIS Web App link, but anonymous ArcGIS REST metadata was inaccessible and the separate Web GIS database requires login. No safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Urdu discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-7154-muzaffarabad.json. AJK Board of Revenue and Land Use Planning custody/project evidence was distinguished from a verified local public registry service.
requestOutcomes: Ten routes were attempted: official Land Use Planning, map, GIS database, GIS Lab, and Board of Revenue references were reviewed; the linked ArcGIS Web App shell returned HTTP 200 but both org and public item REST metadata requests returned HTTP 400 inaccessible-item errors; the separate Web GIS route returned an HTTP 200 login page; two AJK pages returned Cloudflare HTTP 403 challenges. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe field, parcel ID, or geometry was requested or retained.
scopeLimits: AJK Board of Revenue project evidence and general agency pages are not treated as a confirmed city-local registry endpoint; registryFound remains null.
No public parcel API, viewer configuration, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was verified.
No exact WUP-point hit or miss was obtained; the exact point remains [34.3645883375898, 73.4708139484832] in latitude/longitude order.
The login wall, inaccessible ArcGIS item, Cloudflare challenges, and non-parcel map pages are access/scope limitations, not citywide absence evidence.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
credentials, private tokens and personal data
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. Any future retained sample must contain exactly one stable native ID in properties, with source field mapping kept in this review.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable public parcel geometry service was reached. No hit/miss inference was made.
